identification: Four Australian pre-decimal silver coins: 1915 florin (George V, mint mark unconfirmed), 1921 shilling, 1918 sixpence, 1918 threepence. Only the florin matters. Photo is 800x600 and the enlarged crop shows a tiny blob below the date between the 1 and 5 that could be an H, but it is not resolvable. Plain 1915 (London) florin is worth about melt to modest dollars; 1915H is scarcer and worth roughly $50 to $90 in F to VF.

viewing_check: Look under the date on the florin reverse for a small H (1915H) with a loupe; plain 1915 has none. Also check florin grade and whether the sixpence and threepence dates are 1918 (no premium either way).
